tools.name: compose_contact_email
tools.description: Open the user’s own email client with a pre-filled draft to the channel’s public contact address. Nothing is sent by this tool — the user reviews and sends (or discards) the draft themselves. Returns JSON {status: "mail_draft_opened", to, subject}.

subject.description: Subject line for the draft email.

body.description: Optional body text for the draft email.

tools.name: get_channel_info
tools.description: Return structured facts about this documentary channel: name, premise, YouTube channel URL, contact email, signature sign-off, and the latest posts. No input. Read-only, no side effects. Returns JSON {name, tagline, premise, youtube, email, signoff, latest_posts: [{title, slug, url, date, description}]}.

tools.name: get_current_post
tools.description: Return the blog post open in this tab right now: its metadata plus the full markdown source (frontmatter includes the cited sources). No input. Read-only, no side effects. Returns JSON {slug, url, title, date, description, markdown} — or {error}.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch one blog post: its metadata plus the full markdown source (which includes the frontmatter with the post’s cited sources). Input: the post slug (e.g. "why-x-happened") or its /posts/<slug>/ URL, as returned by search_posts. Read-only, no side effects. Returns JSON {slug, url, title, date, description, markdown} — or {error} for an unknown slug.

slug.description: Post slug or /posts/<slug>/ URL from search_posts.

tools.name: get_post_sources
tools.description: Return the cited sources (the receipts) of one blog post: each source’s note and URL where one exists. Input: the post slug from search_posts. Read-only, no side effects. Returns JSON {slug, title, sources: [{note, url}]} — or {error} for an unknown slug.

slug.description: Post slug or /posts/<slug>/ URL from search_posts.

tools.name: open_youtube_channel
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the channel’s YouTube page so the user can watch episodes or subscribe. No input. Changes the current page (reversible with the Back button); performs no purchase, login or subscription by itself. Returns JSON {status: "navigating", url}.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search this site’s blog posts by keyword over title and description (case-insensitive substring), newest first. An empty or missing query matches every post. Paginated via limit/offset. Read-only, no side effects. Returns JSON {query, total, returned, offset, has_more, next_offset, posts: [{title, slug, url, date, description}]}.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to match against post titles and descriptions. Empty matches all posts.

limit.description: Maximum posts to return in this page of results.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return; pass next_offset from the previous call to page.
